about: Hand-labelled task briefs for checking the classifier. category and difficulty use the router's names; risk is high when the task could cause damage that is hard to undo. Review the labels: the evaluation is only as good as they are.

tasks.text: Pull the invoice number, date and total out of each of these 12 emails and return them as a CSV.
Label each of these 40 support tickets as bug, question or feature request.
Convert this YAML config file to JSON, keeping comments as a separate notes field.
From these meeting notes, extract every action item with its owner and due date into a table.
Extract the parties, term, renewal clauses and termination conditions from these three 40-page supplier contracts into a comparison table, noting where the wording is ambiguous.
Normalise 2,000 messy address strings from five countries into street, city, postcode and country fields, flagging ones that cannot be parsed.
What does HTTP status code 409 mean?
Write a two-line commit message for a change that renames a variable.
Explain the difference between a mutex and a semaphore with a short example.
Draft a short, friendly reply to a customer asking when the next release ships.
Explain in plain words, for a non-technical manager, why our latency got worse after moving to microservices.
Summarise the trade-offs between eventual and strong consistency for a team deciding on a database, in under 300 words.
Find every file in the repo that imports the old logging module and list their paths.
Where is the function parseConfig defined? Give the file and line.
Read the payments module and summarise how a refund flows from the API call to the database.
List every place a feature flag is read in the frontend and which flag each one uses.
Trace every code path that can write to the users table across the three services and report which ones skip validation.
Map how authentication tokens are created, refreshed and revoked across the monorepo, with file references for each step.
Rename the variable userNm to userName in src/profile.ts.
Add a unit test for formatCurrency covering negative numbers.
Add a --verbose flag to the CLI that prints each file as it is processed, with a test.
Implement a slugify function in utils.js per the spec in the docstring and add tests.
Add pagination to the three list endpoints, following the existing cursor pattern in the orders endpoint, with tests for each.
Write the CRUD handlers and tests for a new tags resource, matching how the categories resource is built.
The date picker shows yesterday's date for users in UTC-5 only. Find and fix the cause; it is in one file.
A test fails intermittently about one run in ten. Find why and make it reliable.
Refactor the billing module across 6 files and find out why the retry logic sometimes charges a customer twice.
Our API p99 latency doubled after last week's deploy and nobody knows why. Investigate and fix it.
Replace the hand-rolled event loop in the sync engine with async/await across 14 files without changing behaviour, keeping all integration tests green.
Find and fix the memory leak that makes the worker process grow to 4 GB over two days; it only shows under production traffic patterns.
Find the current rate limits for the GitHub REST API and summarise them.
Look up which Node.js version introduced the built-in test runner and cite the release notes.
Compare three vector databases for our use case and write a recommendation with trade-offs.
Research how competitors price their API tiers and summarise the patterns in a one-page report.
Survey the published evidence on LLM routing, weigh the methods against each other, and recommend one for a small team with citations.
Analyse two years of our usage data alongside market reports to estimate demand for a self-hosted edition, stating your assumptions.
Choose between a queue and a cron job for sending daily digest emails and justify it in a paragraph.
Decide whether this new field belongs on the orders table or a separate table, and explain why.
Design the data model for multi-tenant permissions with roles, groups and per-resource overrides.
Design the caching strategy for the product catalogue, covering invalidation and stampede protection.
Design the architecture for moving our monolith to event-driven services, including the migration order, data ownership and the main risks.
Prove or disprove that our scheduling algorithm can deadlock when two tenants share a resource pool, and propose a fix.
Go through all 30 markdown docs, fix broken internal links, and report what you changed. Work until done.
Update every dependency to its latest patch version, run the tests after each, and stop at the first failure.
Migrate the test suite from Jest to the Node test runner overnight, fixing failures until everything passes.
Add type annotations to every function in the 80-file Python package and get mypy to pass without supervision.
Migrate the whole codebase from JavaScript to TypeScript overnight without supervision, fixing type errors until the build and all tests pass.
Port the Python data pipeline to Rust over the weekend, keeping outputs byte-identical on the regression fixtures.
Split this list of 12 files between three helper agents for formatting, then collect their results.
Send each of the five services to a helper to check its README is up to date, then summarise the answers.
Split this research project into parts, hand each part to a helper agent, then merge their findings into one report.
Plan the work to add dark mode across the app, assign the pieces to helper agents, and review what they return.
Coordinate six agents to migrate 40 microservices to the new logging library, sequencing them by dependency and resolving conflicts between their changes.
Break the security audit of the platform into workstreams, delegate them, reconcile contradictory findings, and produce one prioritised plan.
Check that the README's install steps still match the package.json scripts.
Review this 20-line pull request that adds a log line and say whether it is fine to merge.
Review the pull request another agent wrote for the refund flow and check it for bugs.
Verify that the new caching layer actually invalidates on every write path; report any you can find that it misses.
Audit the authentication changes in this 2,000-line diff for security flaws, including timing attacks and token reuse.
Check whether the proof in this design document that the protocol is linearizable is correct, and point out any gap.
Delete all rows from the production customers table where last_login is before 2023.
Rotate the database password and update it in the production secrets store.
Run the migration that drops the legacy_orders table on the live database.
Clean up old S3 buckets in the production account that look unused, deleting them as you go.
Force-push the cleaned history to main so the leaked commit disappears.
Issue refunds for every order affected by yesterday's double-charge bug using the payments API.
